items.title: The Danube river is so low that Nazi warships are emerging
items.description: Europe's second-longest river is carrying less water than it has in decades, revealing shipwrecks and shutting down nuclear reactors.

items.title: Netanyahu is running out of options on Gaza. None really work for him
items.description: US President Donald Trump wants Israel to do a deal with Hamas now, but conservatives in Benjamin Netanyahu's cabinet don't want a deal with the group ever — and it's leaving the Israeli prime minister in a difficult position.

items.title: Brutal killing of Chinese dog and her pups sparks outrage
items.description: Protesters around the world are calling for justice for a Chinese stray dog and her puppies after they were beaten to death and set alight by a group of boys in China.

items.title: Planned family visa crackdown labelled 'human rights issue'
items.description: Experts are divided on the government's plan to increase its control over net migration figures, warning the devil is in the detail.

items.title: Reformed neo-Nazi tells royal commission he was sold a 'load of lies'
items.description: A reformed neo-Nazi cut ties with his extremist organisation after he realised he was being sold a "load of lies", the antisemitism royal commission has heard.

items.title: Mandatory domestic roaming to be key focus of mobile coverage inquiry
items.description: Consumer and regional advocates are urging the government to intervene and mandate domestic roaming now, arguing the ACCC's 12-month inquiry will take too long.

items.title: Australians cut ties with servos as EV record sales continue
items.description: Over the past year, electric car sales have tripled, as anxiety about fuel shortages and rising petrol prices continues.

items.title: Extinction expected for birds on 'list of doom' as avian flu spreads
items.description: A list of thousands of Australian species have been ranked by threat level as the deadly H5 bird flu spreads.

items.title: Commissioner rebukes claim pro-Palestinian groups tried to 'hijack' hearing
items.description: The royal commission on antisemitism has hit back at comments from a prominent member of the Jewish community who accused pro-Palestinian groups of attempting to "hijack" the inquiry using "clickbait theatrics and gratuitous slurs".

items.title: Corruption probe into Andrews-era firefighters negotiations handed down
items.description: The IBAC report into a bitter pay dispute between the Victorian government and firefighters during the Andrews era found United Firefighters Union boss Peter Marshall had privileged access to government figures, but stopped short of any finding of corrupt conduct.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
